intelligence.human_view: A minus nine is not a bad ten — it is the opposite of what he asked for. He asked for a small extraordinary object that changes color every day, something people look at and say wow. He got text next to a shape that fades into nothing. The text was the giveaway: if the piece needs a label to say what frequency it is, the piece has already failed — the color is supposed to BE the frequency. A real object does not need to announce itself.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine someone asks you to make a magic jewel that changes color every day, and you draw a flat circle and write the color's name next to it. The name is not the magic — the color changing is. Make the real jewel, and let the color do the talking.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he wanted a beautiful little jewel, dear, that changes its color every single day, dear — something so beautiful people say wow, dear. And we gave him a flat shape with words next to it, dear. The color IS the words, dear — so we take the words away, dear, and make the jewel real, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: A TEN, NOT A MINUS NINE. THE SIGNATURE PIECE IS A REAL OBJECT. THE COLOR IS THE FREQUENCY — NO TEXT ON IT.
